title: 「in the sense that」精確說明意思句
titleZh: 「in the sense that」精確說明意思句
titleEn: Using in the sense that to define a precise meaning

source.file: Sentence Structure 129 -「in the sense that」精確說明意思句.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Complete statement +, in the sense that + subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: Complete statement +, in the sense that + subject + verb + other information
Complete statement + only in the sense that + subject + verb + other information

example: The company is flexible, in the sense that employees can choose their working hours.
exampleZh: 這家公司很有彈性，意思是員工可以自行選擇工作時間。

examples.en: The company is flexible, in the sense that employees can choose their working hours.
examples.zh: 這家公司很有彈性，意思是員工可以自行選擇工作時間。
examples.highlight: in the sense that employees can choose their working hours

rules.zh: that 後面必須接完整子句
rules.en: That must be followed by a complete clause.
examples: The course is practical, in the sense that students solve real problems.

rules.zh: 這是一個固定詞組 必須使用： 不要寫成：
rules.en: In the sense that is a fixed expression. Use that exact form, not in a sense that, in the meaning that or in the sense of that.

rules.zh: in the sense that 不等於普通的 because Because 通常解釋事情發生的原因。 In the sense that 則解釋「flexible」具體是指甚麼。
rules.en: In the sense that specifies meaning rather than simply giving a cause. Because normally explains why something happens, whereas in the sense that explains exactly what a general description such as flexible means.
examples: The company is flexible because the manager trusts the employees.
The company is flexible, in the sense that employees can choose their working hours.

rules.zh: 一般形式前通常使用逗號 當使用 only in the sense that 直接限制前面的說法時，通常不需要逗號：
rules.en: The general form normally follows a comma. When only in the sense that directly limits the preceding statement, a comma is not normally used.

rules.zh: 可以用 only 限定說法 Only in the sense that 表示前面的描述並非在所有方面都成立，而只是某一方面成立。
rules.en: Only can limit the scope of the statement: only in the sense that shows that the preceding description is true in one particular respect rather than in every respect.
examples: The timetable is fixed only in the sense that lessons must begin and end at set times.

benefits.zh: 清楚解釋較籠統的詞語 像 fair、flexible、successful 和 practical 等詞語可以有多種意思。這個句型能準確告訴讀者你所 指的是哪一種意思。
benefits.en: It explains general words clearly. Words such as fair, flexible, successful and practical can have several meanings; this structure tells the reader exactly which meaning you intend.

benefits.zh: 避免說法過分籠統 你可以指出一個說法在哪個特定方面成立，而不會令人誤以為它在所有方面都完全正確。
benefits.en: It prevents your claim from sounding too broad. You can explain the particular respect in which a statement is true instead of suggesting that it is true in every possible way.

benefits.zh: 把主要說法和解釋連接起來 你可以把一個概括說法和它的具體解釋連成一句，不需要寫成兩個分開的短句。
benefits.en: It connects a claim with its explanation. Instead of writing two separate sentences, you can place the general description and its exact meaning in one connected sentence.

benefits.zh: 適合討論、作文和職場解釋 當你討論公平、成功、責任、效率或自由等概念時，這個句型可以幫助你準確界定自己的意思。
benefits.en: It is useful in discussions, essays and workplace explanations. This structure helps you define what you mean when discussing ideas such as fairness, success, responsibility, efficiency or freedom.

benefits.zh: 提供實用的口語框架 當別人要求你解釋一個較概括的說法時，你可以直接運用這個框架組織答案。
benefits.en: It gives you a useful speaking frame. When someone asks you to explain a general statement, you can organize the answer with ‘It is ..., in the sense that ...’.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

en: Rewrite each sentence using in the sense that to explain the exact meaning of the main description.
You may use only in the sense that when the original sentence limits the description to one particular respect.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用 in the sense that 改寫以下句子，準確解釋主要描述所指的意思。
如原句表示某項描述只在一個特定方面成立，你可以使用 only in the sense that。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。
